theme.title: Rotation: Value/Defensives → Growth
theme.summary: Communication Svcs (+2.91%) and Technology (+2.64%) led the market today, while Energy (-2.44%) and Utilities (-0.36%) brought up the rear. Growth sectors outpaced the rest, averaging +2.40% versus -0.15% for defensives and +0.20% for value, consistent with risk appetite favoring higher-beta names. Major indices moved in a tighter band — S&P 500 +1.52%, Dow +1.22%, Nasdaq +2.21% — without one clearly dominating. Small caps moved roughly in line with the broader market, with the Russell 2000 at +1.73%. The VIX fell 0.88% to 15.85, which reads as an orderly rotation rather than panic-driven selling. Gold slipped 0.67% to $4,092.40, crude oil was little changed at $79.71, and bitcoin gained 0.52% — cross-asset moves weren't all pointing the same direction as equities.
